ticker.description: US ticker, e.g. TSLA or BRK.B
ticker.title: Ticker

step.description: The step now running, while status is running
step.title: Step

tracked.description: Already tracked. Adding it again brings its data up to date
tracked.title: Tracked

items.description: The newest few, positive and negative only
items.title: Items

positive.description: Positive stories in the window, each counted once
positive.title: Positive

score_before.description: The same score for the 7 days before that
score_before.title: Score Before

score_now.description: News score over the last 7 days, -1 to +1
score_now.title: Score Now

headlines.description: Stories published that day (UTC). Timing only: headlines can't show why a price moved
headlines.title: Headlines

market_wide.description: Most tracked companies moved the same way that day, so this may not be about the company
market_wide.title: Market Wide

previous_date.description: The earlier stored close this move is measured against (usually the day before)
previous_date.title: Previous Date

threshold_pct.description: The size a move had to reach to be listed for this company
threshold_pct.title: Threshold Pct

typical_pct.description: The company's median daily move (absolute) over the days before the window; null without enough history
typical_pct.title: Typical Pct

as_of.description: Newest stored price date across the companies; null if there are no prices
as_of.title: As Of

days.description: Trading days in the window (with `since`, how many stored days came after it: 0 if none)
days.title: Days

filings.description: Filed on or after the window's first day, newest first
filings.title: Filings

newest_filing.description: The newest stored filing of any company, shown when `filings` is empty

since.description: The `since` date that was asked for, if any
since.title: Since

stale.description: Companies with no price for the newest date, so the window may be missing their latest days
stale.title: Stale

window_start.description: First trading day in the window
window_start.title: Window Start

history.description: Earlier turns of the conversation, oldest first, so a follow-up like 'and its risks?' can be understood. The newest three are used
history.title: History

symbols.description: Tickers to restrict to. Default: detected from the question
symbols.title: Symbols

cautions.description: Plain-language warnings to show with the answer, for example when it may suggest a reason for a price move that the data cannot show, or when a financial figure it quotes can mislead (a P/E flattered by investment gains)
cautions.title: Cautions

evidence_kinds.description: The kinds of source the model was shown (not only the ones it cited), so the screen can say what was looked at
evidence_kinds.title: Evidence Kinds

grounded.description: True when the answer cites at least one real source
grounded.title: Grounded

interpreted_question.description: How a follow-up was understood (the standalone question that was searched). Null if the question was used as written
interpreted_question.title: Interpreted Question

model_route.description: The kinds of data the local model chose to look at, because the keyword rules found no specific kind for this question. Empty when the keyword rules decided, the model was not asked, or it chose the same as the keywords. It says what the model chose, not what was found: evidence_kinds says what the answer was written from
model_route.title: Model Route

refused.description: True when nothing relevant was found or no company was named, so the model wasn't asked
refused.title: Refused

unverified_numbers.description: Figures in the answer that are not in the cited sources, a minus sign the sources don't have, or a price move described in the wrong direction. Show a warning if non-empty
unverified_numbers.title: Unverified Numbers

searchable.description: True once the filing has been embedded for search
searchable.title: Searchable

growth.description: The latest period vs the same period a year earlier (0.12 = up 12%); null if it can't be told
growth.title: Growth

how.description: How the figure was built, in plain words, with the dates
how.title: How

period_end.description: Where the latest filed period ends
period_end.title: Period End

sources.description: The SEC filings it came from, e.g. '10-Q filed 2026-07-31 (9 months to 2026-06-27)'
sources.title: Sources

FundamentalsOut.description: Figures computed from the SEC filings. Every ratio is worked out in Python; cautions explain where a correct number could mislead.

diluted_eps.description: Dollars per share over the last twelve months

gross_margin.description: A fraction: 0.5 = 50%. Null if the company reports no gross profit
gross_margin.title: Gross Margin

market_value.description: Shares times the latest close, in dollars
market_value.title: Market Value

net_income.description: Dollars over the last twelve months, the part belonging to shareholders

operating_income.description: Dollars over the last twelve months

pe.description: Latest close divided by diluted EPS for the last twelve months; null when earnings are zero or negative
pe.title: Pe

pe_note.description: Why P/E is missing, when it is
pe_note.title: Pe Note

period_end.description: End of the latest reported period behind the figures
period_end.title: Period End

price.description: The latest stored close, used for market value and P/E
price.title: Price

revenue.description: Dollars over the last twelve months

unavailable_reason.description: Why there are no figures (not downloaded yet, or a foreign filer), when available is false
unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason

FundamentalsOut.title: FundamentalsOut

HistoryTurn.description: An earlier question and its answer. Only used to understand a follow-up; never treated as evidence.
HistoryTurn.title: HistoryTurn

sentiment.description: positive, negative, neutral, irrelevant, or null if not scored yet
sentiment.title: Sentiment

symbol.description: The company this headline was labeled for. A headline about two companies appears once for each
symbol.title: Symbol

sentiment.description: positive, negative, neutral, irrelevant, or null if not scored yet
sentiment.title: Sentiment

verdict.description: ADDED, ADDED, WITH GAPS, UPDATED, or NOT ADDED (with WITH GAPS when something is missing)
verdict.title: Verdict

status.description: OK, NONE, SKIPPED, FAILED, or -- (not tried)
status.title: Status

score.description: -1 (all bad news) to +1 (all good); null if no scored headlines. Each story is counted once, and stock-quote and comparison pages are left out of every count
score.title: Score

source.description: Where the count was read, in words
source.title: Source

as_of.description: The filing date for a filing, otherwise the date of the data
as_of.title: As Of

kind.description: filing = a passage from an SEC filing; price = figures worked out from stored daily closes; headline = a news title; sentiment = a summary of headline labels; fundamentals = revenue, profit, margins, market value and P/E worked out from SEC filings and the latest price
kind.title: Kind

number.description: Matches the [n] citation in the answer
number.title: Number

score.description: Filings only: how closely the passage matched the question
score.title: Score

title.description: One line saying what this source is, e.g. 'NVDA 10-K filed 2026-02-25' or 'NVDA price data (stored daily closes), as of 2026-10-12'
title.title: Title

url.description: Where to read it: the filing or the headline's article. Null for price and sentiment sources
url.title: Url

as_of.description: Date of this company's newest stored price, null if it has none
as_of.title: As Of

as_of.description: Date of the latest price bar. During market hours it can be a partial day
as_of.title: As Of

as_of.description: Date of the latest price bar. During market hours it can be a partial day
as_of.title: As Of
